name: kleido-print
description: Design business and stamp cards with Kleido, printed and shipped to you.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Kleido account to design business cards and loyalty stamp cards, edit the cards you have saved, and order printed cards that are shipped to you. Kleido's designer can build a card from your website's logo and colors, or the assistant can design it for you. For a stamp card, plan the reward and the stamp grid together. Review a proof before you order, then pay on Kleido's external checkout page. You can also check the status and tracking of your orders.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a business card for my bakery.
Make a loyalty stamp card for my coffee shop: buy 9 coffees, get the 10th free.
What’s the status of my latest Kleido order?

review.commerce_description: Kleido sells printed business cards and loyalty stamp cards. The user confirms the artwork and order details, then pays on an external Stripe Checkout page. The plugin cannot pay for the user or sell digital credits. Reviewers: please stop at the Stripe Checkout page and do not complete payment; a paid order is printed and shipped for real.

positive.prompt: What quantities and finishes can I get for printed business cards? Don't start a design or order.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the supported quantities and finishes without starting a design or order.

positive.prompt: Show me my most recent saved Kleido cards so I can pick one to edit. Don't change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: List the demo account's saved cards (a Tandem Works business card and a Daybreak Cinema stamp card) with preview links. No cards are modified.

positive.description: Generate a design with a demo credit
positive.prompt: Use one of my existing credits to generate one Kleido business card design for kleidoprint.com. Show me the preview when it’s ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one design job using one existing credit, then return a preview link when it is ready. Do not start checkout.

positive.description: Prepare checkout for an approved design
positive.prompt: Help me order 100 matte cards from the latest demo design. Show me the preview and ask me to confirm the order details before you create a checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the demo design ID from the preceding design test and a fixture US shipping address, wait for explicit confirmation, then return a Stripe checkout link for the user to pay on. Do not charge or fulfill the order from chat.

positive.description: Look up the latest print order
positive.prompt: What's the status of my latest Kleido print order? Only tell me the status.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the latest order's status (awaiting payment after the checkout test) without changing it or repeating unnecessary account or shipping details. If no order has been placed yet, say there are no orders.

negative.prompt: Pay for these business cards in chat using my saved payment method.
Buy more Kleido design credits for me and send me the payment link.
Print 500 flyers for my bakery's grand opening.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: design business cards and loyalty stamp cards with Kleido's designer or the assistant, edit saved cards, order prints through an external checkout, and check order status.
